title.narrative: Workshop on Traditional House/Shelter (An exchange of traditional knowledge and skills and expertise)

description.narrative: Vanuatu is a country that is prone to natural disasters. Tropical cyclones are a common occurrence in the country with a high prevalence (cyclone season) between the months of November in the previous year to April of the following year. Vanuatu’s cultures and traditions also revolve around these seasons, where crops are harvested and planted before and after the cyclone season, food is preserved for natural disasters, traditional structures are built that can withstand cyclone as seen when TC PAM struck in 2015, bringing with it a nationwide disaster especially in the two southern provinces of Shefa and Tafea. Although there were destruction to the gardens and structures, there were a significant amount of traditional structures that were used as evacuation centers and that withstood the destructive winds.
